item: D1 slice 1 of the full perp universe: name list and first-date inventory
pre_registered: research/log.md, 2026-11-02, before any count was computed
reason: The inventory covers today's listings only. Every one of the 2,092 names has its last bar on 2026-11-02, so none is a delisted name. The history endpoint does serve delisted names by symbol: FTTUSDT_PERP.A returned 214 bars ending 2022-11-14 and SRMUSDT_PERP.A returned 802 bars ending 2022-11-15, and neither symbol is in future-markets. No endpoint lists them. include_delisted=true returned the same list and /delisted-future-markets returned 404.

delisted_probe.include_delisted_true: HTTP 200, same payload size as the plain list, no extra names

not_done: The six-series panel (price, volume, funding, open interest, liquidations, long/short) was not pulled. This slice is the name list only.
Delisted names are reachable by symbol but no endpoint enumerates them, so the point-in-time universe still cannot be built.
Open interest history starts 2022-09-19, so the inventory's first bar is a price bar, not an open-interest bar.
resume_from: data/universe.json holds 2,092 symbols and scripts/build_universe.py skips symbols already saved. The next slice needs a list of delisted symbols from outside Coinalyze, then the same history request by symbol.
